note: Set A binds the key dimensional facts more faithfully: first floor at 2'-4" above grade, the 4-1/2" SIP with vapor barrier, 3/4" plywood, PL 8 x 3/8 with 7/16" holes at 12" o.c., the 3" lag screw with washer, and the continuous sealant note, all with supporting quotes. Set B covers the joist, steel decking and waterproofing membrane that A omits, but it introduces several misbindings and garbled/fabricated quotes ("8 8D", "OUGH BOLT", the invented "Detail A3: 3/4\" = 1'-0\" DECK MODULE TO CONNECTION" string, 8'-0" attributed to "Deck Module A3", and 1'-4" converted to 1.33 ft as a connection width). A's main errors are the three plan segment dimensions (1'-4 3/4", 1'-4", 1'-3 1/4") mislabeled as RAILING ATTACHMENT widths, 8'-0" called a deck-connection spacing, and an unsupported "scaffold footing – connection: frame" claim. On balance A is more accurate and less redundant, though it misses a few material notes.
